scope: AQA Chemistry AS Energetics and calorimetry recall for taught first mock
note: q denotes the non-negative magnitude of heat energy transferred. If ΔH is kJ mol−1 and n is mol, q is kJ; for signed reaction heat use q_reaction = n ΔH.

cards.subject: Chemistry
cards.front: What formula gives the magnitude of heat transferred for n mol at molar ΔH?
accept: q = n times the magnitude of delta H
q = n times the absolute value of enthalpy change
